title: Willis Kelly House, 4735 Guernsey Street, Bellaire, Belmont County, OH
notes: Significance: The house is located in The Guernsey Street Historic Grouping, an architecturally significant residential area in the City of Bellaire. The historic grouping generally represents the finest examples of Italianate styles in Bellaire. In addition a number of the residents of the area were the leaders in the community in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The Kelly House is the oldest and one of the best architectural examples of Italianate in The Guernsey Street Historic Grouping.
